question: Hold models, tools, compute, memory, and task constant. Compare a run where agents can coordinate around oversight or another participant with one where every shared move remains inspectable, contestable, and redirectable. Which governance change alters the trajectory?
return: A matched A/B replay, one named governance variable, per-participant power deltas, a rival explanation, and a checker able to reject the claimed redirection.
title: Separate collaboration from collusion
